id.description: Unique food buff record identifier (UUID v4).

petId.description: Pet this food buff is applied to.

foodType.description: Application-defined food item identifier (e.g. 'speed_berry', 'iron_kibble'). Used by the client to render the correct food icon and label.

buffStat.description: Stat affected by this food buff.

magnitude.description: Stat points granted. Must be > 0. Admin-configurable multiplier range: 0.5×–5.0×.

isPermanent.description: TRUE = buff never expires (expiresAt is null). FALSE = buff has a finite duration (expiresAt is non-null).

effectType.description: Derived from isPermanent: 'permanent' when isPermanent = true, 'temporary' when isPermanent = false.

expiresAt.description: NULL for permanent buffs. Set to consumedAt + duration for temporary buffs.

consumedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the food item was applied to the pet.

recordExpiresAt.description: consumedAt + 30 days. Target for background cleanup job. Always >= expiresAt.
